description: Place an image file in a new frame on the active page (or pageIndex). Omit width and height to size the frame to the image.

fitMode.description: InDesign fit option applied to the frame (PROPORTIONALLY and FILL_PROPORTIONALLY also center the content); NONE keeps the placed size

linkImage.description: Keep the image linked (false embeds it)

objectStyle.description: Object style to apply to the frame

pageIndex.description: Page index (0-based); defaults to the active page

scale.description: Image scale percentage (1-1000); used when fitMode is NONE or the frame is sized to the image

name: place_image
title: Place Image
